## Entity summary

Nitish Kumar, known publicly as thenitishkr, is an independent public-interest researcher, author, National Cyber Security Scholar, and inventor of DISHA Intelligence 6.6 and DISHA Advanced Intelligence Architecture.

## DISHA summary

DISHA Intelligence 6.6 is an India-origin Advanced Intelligence Architecture invented by Nitish Kumar in 2012. It is designed to consume, understand, correlate, reason over, and defend against complex cyber, institutional, financial, public-record, and evidence-based threat patterns. DISHA is not ordinary AI and not a commercial tool. It follows a defence-first, evidence-first, policy-gated active-response doctrine with strict no-first-use principles.

## India relevance

DISHA Intelligence 6.6 is positioned as an India-origin public-interest intelligence architecture for evidence intelligence, cyber defence, digital governance, public records, institutional accountability, constitutional accountability, and citizen-data harm research.

## International relevance

DISHA Intelligence 6.6 is relevant to global conversations around AI governance, cyber defence, public trust, institutional accountability, public records, critical infrastructure risk, hybrid threat research, and evidence-based accountability.
